title: Tactus-web slice 1: inventory pages as prose-only vs component-bearing, and map each MDX/React component to a Markus directive or island
description: Tactus-web already builds the standard library and examples pages through Papyrus (publication/, PR 7). List every other page in src/pages and src/content, mark prose-only vs uses @anthus/tactus-hitl-components, video players, citation manager or Remotion; decide directive or island per component.
